name: New Client Kickoff Kit

parameters.content:
## New Client Kickoff Kit

### How it works

1. Fires when a client is marked signed (wire this to your CRM/PM tool's own 'signed' action, or trigger it manually).
2. Creates a Drive matter folder with your firm's standard subfolders already inside it.
3. Sends a kickoff email with a Calendly link to schedule the kickoff meeting, compliance-checked and logged through the Bar-Compliance Guardrail.
4. Creates your firm's configured follow-up tasks in Clio (e.g. 'send engagement letter', 'confirm signed retainer').
5. Logs the whole kickoff to a master onboarding sheet -- one row per new client, including whether the Drive folder actually got created.
6. Separately, a weekly rollup reports how many clients were onboarded and flags any Drive folder creation failures for manual follow-up.

**This assumes your welcome-email day sequence (Day 0/1/3/7) is already handled elsewhere** -- if you haven't deployed the Client Onboarding Sequence template (K7) yet, deploy that first for the actual welcome/what-to-expect emails. This kit is scoped specifically to what that template doesn't do: the Drive folder, the Calendly kickoff link, and the master onboarding log.

**This never touches legal work** (ABA Op. 512) -- folder creation, scheduling links, and task creation are pure administrative setup.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Deploy the Client Onboarding Sequence template (K7) first if you haven't -- this kit doesn't duplicate its welcome-email sequence.
- [ ] Set up the Bar-Compliance Guardrail (NTC-33) -- the kickoff email goes through it.
- [ ] Configure a Google API (Drive) credential, a Clio OAuth2 credential (reuse if already deployed), and Google Sheets OAuth2 and SMTP credentials.
- [ ] Set the required n8n Variables: FIRM_NAME, FIRM_FROM_EMAIL, GUARDRAIL_WORKFLOW_ID, ONBOARDING_DRIVE_PARENT_FOLDER_ID, CALENDLY_KICKOFF_EVENT_URL, CLIO_BASE_URL, ONBOARDING_LOG_SHEET_ID.
- [ ] Optionally tune ONBOARDING_DRIVE_SUBFOLDERS and ONBOARDING_FOLLOWUP_TASKS.
- [ ] Activate the workflow and wire your 'client signed' action to the webhook URL.

### Customization

ONBOARDING_DRIVE_SUBFOLDERS and ONBOARDING_FOLLOWUP_TASKS are the entire structure/task surface -- edit those n8n Variables, not the code.

## Create the Drive matter folder and standard subfolders

Builds a top-level matter folder plus your firm's configured standard subfolders inside it, the moment a client is marked signed.

## Kickoff email, follow-up tasks, and the master log

Sends the kickoff email with a Calendly scheduling link, creates configured follow-up tasks in Clio, and logs the whole kickoff to a master sheet.

## Weekly onboarding kit rollup — a second, independent branch

Reports how many clients were onboarded this week and flags any Drive folder creation failures for manual follow-up.

nodes.name: When Client Marked Signed
nodes.notes: Wire your CRM/PM tool's 'mark as signed' action (or a simple button/Zapier step) to POST here with the client's name, email, matter ID, practice area, and attorney contact.

nodes.name: Parse Signed Client Data
nodes.notes: Field names here match a generic 'mark as signed' payload — adjust to whatever your CRM/PM tool actually sends.

nodes.name: Create Matter Drive Folder
nodes.notes: Creates the top-level matter folder inside your configured parent folder (ONBOARDING_DRIVE_PARENT_FOLDER_ID). Needs a Google API (OAuth2) credential with Drive scope -- wire it manually after import. neverError is on so a failure doesn't halt the rest of kickoff -- checked in the next node.

nodes.name: Parse Folder Creation Response
nodes.notes: Reads the previous node's raw HTTP response, not $json passthrough -- checks for a Drive API error and continues either way.

nodes.name: Build Subfolder List
nodes.notes: ONBOARDING_DRIVE_SUBFOLDERS controls the whole structure -- edit that n8n Variable, not the code.

nodes.name: Create Drive Subfolder
nodes.notes: Runs once per subfolder from the list above, nested inside the matter folder just created.

nodes.name: Build Kickoff Email
nodes.notes: CALENDLY_KICKOFF_EVENT_URL is your firm's scheduling link for the kickoff-meeting event type — reads from 'Parse Folder Creation Response' by name so this runs independent of how many subfolders were created.

nodes.name: Check Compliance Before Kickoff Email
nodes.notes: Real communication to a real client -- opt-out and disclaimer handling here are genuinely load-bearing.

nodes.name: Send Kickoff Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Kickoff Email' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

nodes.name: Skip — Client Opted Out
nodes.notes: Rare for a brand-new signed client, but respected the same as any other opt-out check in this catalog.

nodes.name: Build Onboarding Follow-Up Task List
nodes.notes: ONBOARDING_FOLLOWUP_TASKS controls which tasks get created and when — edit that n8n Variable, not the code.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ data: { name: $json.task_name + ' — ' + $json.client_name, due_at: $json.due_date + 'T00:00:00.000Z', matter: { id: $json.matter_id }, status: 'pending', priority: 'normal' } }) }}

nodes.name: Create Clio Follow-Up Task
nodes.notes: Runs once per configured task from the previous step, landing in your firm's normal Clio task queue.

nodes.name: Log Onboarding To Master Sheet
nodes.notes: One row per new client, regardless of whether the Drive folder or kickoff email succeeded -- runs in parallel with those branches, not gated behind them. folder_created lets you spot any manual follow-up needed.

nodes.name: Read Full Onboarding Log
nodes.notes: Reads every logged onboarding, regardless of week.

nodes.name: Compute Weekly Onboarding Summary
nodes.notes: ONBOARDING_SUMMARY_LOOKBACK_DAYS controls the window — defaults to 7.

nodes.name: Build Weekly Onboarding Email
nodes.notes: Explicitly sends a 'no new clients' message rather than a blank digest when nothing came in this week.

nodes.name: Send Weekly Onboarding Email
nodes.notes: Internal, firm-wide summary — no guardrail wrap needed, matching this catalog's other weekly rollups.

description: Fires when a client is marked signed. Creates a Drive matter folder with the firm's configured standard subfolders, sends a kickoff email with a Calendly scheduling link through the Bar-Compliance Guardrail, creates configured follow-up tasks in Clio, and logs the kickoff to a master onboarding sheet. Assumes the welcome-email day sequence is already handled by the Client Onboarding Sequence template (K7) -- scoped specifically to the Drive folder, Calendly link, and master log that template doesn't cover. Separately, a weekly rollup reports onboarding volume and flags Drive folder creation failures.
